transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Ravi. How can I help you today?
Customer: I am so tired of the constant signal drops in my area. I want to cancel my service immediately.
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you have been experiencing these connectivity issues. I understand how frustrating it is when your service isn't working as expected.
Customer: It is just unacceptable. I've already looked at other providers and I'm ready to switch.
Agent: I would like to help you with that request. Before we discuss your account details, could you please provide your account number and full name?
Customer: My name is Sneha Das and my account number is 38986082.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Das. I have your account open now. To proceed with the cancellation, I need to let you know that there is no early-termination fee for your current plan, and your final bill will arrive in your email within seven business days.
Customer: That is a relief. I thought I would be charged extra for leaving.
Agent: I can certainly process that for you. I will now process the cancellation request for your line 99485 90932.
Customer: Thank you, Ravi. I appreciate you making this process quick and easy.
Agent: You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Your service will be deactivated shortly, and the final bill will be sent to sneha.41@examplemail.com. Goodbye!
